speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have increasing yellow discoloration of your eyes and skin; can you tell me exactly how many hours old your baby was when the yellowing first became noticeable?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Physiologic Jaundice of the Breastfed Newborn).

The clinical presentation of jaundice appearing after the first week in a thriving, full-term, exclusively breastfed infant with normal weight gain is classic for this condition. I will not perform further invasive tests unless you have specific concerns about sepsis or blood type incompatibility.
